description: op0 is a governed runtime for agent work that combines company context, explicit approval boundaries, and receipt-backed execution records. It also provides usectx, a hosted memory service for agents at ctx.op0.ai.
summary: op0 exposes a hosted MCP endpoint and HostApi on app.op0.ai plus the hosted usectx memory service on ctx.op0.ai with MCP and HTTP surfaces; auth is mostly bearer-token based, with some public health/readiness endpoints and an in-repo CLI drive path documented but not distributed as a standalone package.

surfaces.name: usectx public probes and try endpoints
